tools.name: eu_fx
tools.description: Use for euro exchange rates: the latest ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates (EUR base, ~30 currencies such as USD, GBP, JPY), the publication date. Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (GET /eu/fx, $0.001 per call), with a link to the full schema; call that URL with an x402 or MP

tools.name: eu_fx_history
tools.description: Use for a short euro exchange rate history: daily ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates of one currency against EUR for up to the last 30 days (ccy=USD, days=1..30), with min. Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (GET /eu/fx/history, $0.002 per call), with a link to the full schema

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "fx-rates-news-weather-data" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: eu_fx, eu_fx_history, rates_reference, news_latest, weather, hazards_near, hazards_near_batch, knowledge_search · Public sink: hazards_near_batch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: eu_fx, eu_fx_history, rates_reference, news_latest, weather, hazards_near, hazards_near_batch, knowledge_search · Public sink: hazards_near_batch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
